evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and updates RPC parameter handling in src/rpc/fees.cpp and src/rpc/server.cpp.
rationale: Improves interface consistency by allowing inner options for `estimatesmartfee` to be passed as top-level named arguments. As noted by the author, 'estimatesmartfee is the only RPC that rejects named arguments for options, which seems confusing and not user friendly.'
